## Context
Stub (needs /dso:brainstorm before implementation). Epic dso-uvyl (migration-aware implementation-plan) reads a rollout:feature-flags-approved tag to permit feature-flag-based rollout tasks and otherwise prohibits them. This follow-on covers the producer side: surfacing rollout strategy during brainstorm for migration-class epics and writing that approval tag on explicit user consent.

## Success Criteria
- /dso:brainstorm surfaces feature-flag rollout as a strategy option for migration-class / DB-migration epics (config-gated; not applied unilaterally).
- On explicit user approval, brainstorm writes the rollout:feature-flags-approved tag on the epic; without approval, no tag is written.
- The tag written here is the same signal consumed by dso-uvyl's planner feature-flag gate.

## Dependencies
Relates to dso-uvyl (consumer of the tag).

## Approach
TBD — deferred to a dedicated /dso:brainstorm pass (scrutiny:pending stub).
